responsibility: Contains the rs6000 machine-description support for memory barriers and atomic operations. It defines sync/lwsync/isync patterns, load-linked/store-conditional forms across supported scalar and quadword modes, memory-model-aware expanders for fences, loads, stores, compare-and-swap, exchange, and atomic fetch-update families, making it the RTL pattern layer that lowers GCC atomic builtins and C/C++ atomics onto PowerPC synchronization instructions.
